task: Does this selected file pair have a functional relationship worth inspecting?
population: One preselected pair per constructed case, four cases total; not a sampled OSS corpus or a bug detector.

cases.name: function_contract
cases.reason: The caller imports and calls the changed function.

cases.name: compatible_related
cases.reason: The caller depends on the changed function even though the combined change passes.

cases.name: unrelated
cases.reason: The synthetic banner has no functional dependency on pricing; comment co-edits are incidental.

cases.name: dynamic_lookup
cases.reason: The synthetic caller dynamically loads this function; the static projection does not resolve that lookup.
